description:
About the Position

Uppsala University invites applications for a doctoral position in psychology at the DiVE Lab, working within developmental psychology. The lab studies development and individual variation, and the doctoral project contributes to the lab's programme on how developmental processes unfold and vary between children and contexts.

The candidate will design and run empirical studies, work with developmental datasets and receive structured training in research methods, statistics and academic writing through the university's doctoral programme. Doctoral students in Sweden are employed on paid contracts with collective-agreement salaries and benefits.

Candidate Profile

Applicants hold a master's degree in psychology or a related behavioural-science field and meet the general and specific admission requirements for third-cycle studies in psychology. Strong quantitative skills and experience with child or adolescent research populations are advantages. The working language of the lab is English.

Highlights

  • Developmental psychology and individual variation
  • Empirical study design with developmental populations
  • Quantitative methods and statistics
  • Structured doctoral training in psychology
  • Research environment at the DiVE Lab
  • Paid doctoral employment under Swedish collective agreement
